description: Choose this instead of pre_action_check when the caller integration needs a signed readiness receipt. Performs the same action check once and attaches a short-lived ES256 receipt bound to the exact request and action hashes. No prior pre_action_check call is needed. Without a configured signer, receipt_status is unavailable. The receipt is evidence of this Gate result, not authorization. Require decision_verify to return gate_passed before using it in an enforcement path. Required tool arguments: run_id, actor, requested_action, target, risk_tier, claims, evidence. Supply claim evidence and configure the deployment's ES256 signing key; without it the receipt is unavailable. A receipt is not authorization. Illustrative example arguments (synthetic; replace with your own data): {"run_id":"synthetic-readiness-001","actor":{"id":"example-agent","type":"ai_agent","operator":"Example owner"},"requested_action":"prepare a supplier recommendation for review","target":{"id":"example-supplier","type":"counterparty"},"risk_tier":"low","claims":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim":"The example record says registration is active.","support_level":"direct","evidence_ids":["e1"],"supporting_quotes":[{"evidence_id":"e1","quote":"Registration active"}]}],"evidence":[{"evidence_id":"e1","name":"Synthetic registry excerpt","source_type":"official_document","content":"Registration active"}]}. This product offers 5 free trial attempts for agent_output_verification: call MCP free_trial_status, then MCP free_trial with that tool's own inputSchema arguments; no HTTP adapter or wallet is needed. HTTP alternative: /v1/agent-output/trial; GET that URL for input_schema and example_request, then POST raw tool arguments there (not an MCP/A2A envelope). HTTP, MCP and native A2A share the allowance and daily capacity is limited. Other tools are not included in this trial. Evaluation on paid endpoints requires Base USDC payment or Pro access. Standard x402 v2, when enabled, signs a one-transfer authorization and durably binds its first admitted request. Legacy payment uses a funding-wallet signature over the exact request. Discovery is free. Keep the original request and X-Payment-Signature for result recovery within 24 hours. Current prices: https://output-verification.agendamcp.dpdns.org/.well-known/x402. Do not pay automatically. Evidence triage only: no factual-truth verification, no legal, compliance, sanctions, or financial advice. Human review is required before any commercial action.
